summary: Backend-static verification of Fyers per-account credential isolation fix. Independently re-ran all 4 harnesses, TypeScript typecheck, and full monorepo build. Also performed static git diff review. Everything passes; matches main agent's expected results.

verification_results.fyers_placement_credential_isolation_har: RESULT: ALL PASS (24/24 checks). Verifies: (1) blank FYERS_APP_ID env yields bare adapter with blank App ID (nothing hardcoded); (2) diagnostics show APPID-A / APPID-B (never '(none)' or env sentinel 'ENVLEAK-APP'); (3) ManualTradeService.placeOnMaster calls setCredentials with each account's decrypted App ID independently; (4) OrderActionsService exit/cancel calls setCredentials per-account; (5) structural guard — every `new FyersAdapter()` in manual-trade, order-actions, copy-trading, position-synchronization services is followed by setCredentials() and none reads process.env.FYERS_APP_ID/SECRET_ID.
verification_results.pnpm -r build: exit 0; all 5 workspaces Done (packages/shared, packages/ui, apps/api, apps/web, apps/admin)

confirmed: All four services: `new FyersAdapter()` is immediately followed by adapter.setCredentials(decrypt(encryptedApiKey), decrypt(encryptedApiSecret)) then setAccessToken(accessToken) BEFORE placeOrder/modifyOrder/cancelOrder/getOrders.
OrderActionsService: new private buildFyersAdapter(position, accessToken) helper mirroring buildUpstoxAdapter/buildIciciAdapter; used in modify/cancel/exit branches.
ManualTradeService: placeOnMaster FYERS branch (~L348) and fetchPlacedOrder FYERS branch (~L495) load account and setCredentials before placeOrder/getOrders.
CopyTradingService FYERS follower branch (~L259) and PositionSynchronizationService FYERS follower branch (~L240) call setCredentials from follower.tradingAccount before setAccessToken.
No source reads process.env.FYERS_APP_ID / FYERS_SECRET_ID (only textual comments referencing the removed env behavior remain).
apps/api/src/brokers/fyers/fyers.adapter.ts and fyers.controller.ts are UNCHANGED (git diff empty). OAuth path preserved.
No Prisma schema / migration change. No API request/response contract change.

coverage_boundary_notes: CopyTradingService and PositionSynchronizationService FYERS branches sit inside large multi-account loops that require a live DB to drive end-to-end; per main agent note, they are covered by the structural guard (every `new FyersAdapter()` paired with setCredentials + no env read) rather than a live invocation. This is a known, accepted coverage boundary — not a defect.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly binds per-account App ID/Secret at every Fyers order placement path, aligning with existing ICICI/Upstox branches and with fyers.controller.buildAccountAdapter / broker.service.buildAdapter.
Encryption.decrypt is invoked defensively (ternary guards on encryptedApiKey/Secret), preventing null-decrypt crashes.
No hardcoded App ID/Secret anywhere; env keys FYERS_APP_ID/FYERS_SECRET_ID are effectively deprecated for order placement.
OAuth flow untouched (fyers.controller.ts diff empty) — root cause resolution preserved.
seed_data_creation: None — harnesses use in-memory Prisma/Encryption doubles and stub fyers-api-v3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fyers order-placement credential-isolation fix is verified backend-static. Four services updated; adapter+controller unchanged. Rerun the four .cjs harnesses under /app/backend/tests + `pnpm --filter @cts/api typecheck` + `pnpm -r build` for regression. Live/DB-based end-to-end for CopyTrading and PositionSync FYERS loops remains out of scope in this sandboxed pod.
rca of the issue: Previously every Fyers placement path did `new FyersAdapter()` + setAccessToken only. Adapter's authenticated header `appId:accessToken` therefore used a blank/env FYERS_APP_ID (absent in user's .env) while the OAuth token was minted under the account's per-account App ID → Fyers returned code -50 'Algo orders are not allowed from this app.' Fix: in every placement path load TradingAccount, decrypt encryptedApiKey/encryptedApiSecret, and call adapter.setCredentials(appId, secret) before setAccessToken/placeOrder. Verified via 24-check isolation harness plus structural guard across all 4 services.
